cell_line.evidence: MCF-7 cells were purchased from the German Collection of Microorganisms and Cell Cultures (Deutsche Sammlung von Mikroorganismen und Zellkulturen-DSMZ) and were cultured in RPMI-1640 medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS), 1 mM sodium pyruvate, 1% nonessential amino acids and 10 ng ml−1 insulin.
HEK293 cells were obtained from the American Type Culture Collection and cultured in DMEM medium supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% L-glutamine.
4T1 cells were a kind gift from Sebastian Kobold (LMU Munich, Germany) and were cultured in RPMI-1640 medium supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% L-Glutamine.
